body:
这是一个完全免费的，不收任何赞助的服务器联盟。你可以在这传送到所有不收赞助的盟友服。是的我们是一个联盟，不是个生存服务器，本服提供所有符合条件的盟友服用于传送和监督审核职责。

服务器联盟特色
1：不氪金 不收赞助的正版服 不变相收费在游戏内提供奖励
2：必须正版原版可加入
3：版本需要1.21+
[ 服务器视频介绍](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV187cwzkERV)

关于服务器的具体内容可以查看点击这里查看 [联盟服入驻指南](https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/Ms7ewTneNiYhdRkZ5yXcxiCcnTh?from=from_copylink)


This is a completely free server alliance that accepts no sponsorships. You can teleport to all non-sponsored ally servers here. Yes, we are an alliance, not a survival server. This server provides all eligible ally servers for teleportation and oversight/audit duties.

Server Alliance Features:
1. No pay-to-win: A legitimate server that doesn't accept sponsorships. No hidden charges; in-game rewards are provided.
2. Must be a genuine, original player to join.
3. Requires version 1.21+. Server video introduction.
